# Corpus texts

Static excerpts of public-domain works, used as the long-form Sample corpus for the benchmarks and the accuracy bounds. They are checked in as-is and are not regenerated by any script.

Each file was cleaned once: source boilerplate and markup removed, hard-wrapped lines rejoined into whole paragraphs, one paragraph per line separated by a blank line. Latin-script wraps were rejoined with a space, CJK wraps with nothing.

| File | Work | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `great-gatsby-en.txt` | F. Scott Fitzgerald, _The Great Gatsby_ (1925) – opening of chapter I | [Project Gutenberg 64317](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/64317) |
| `die-verwandlung-de.txt` | Franz Kafka, _Die Verwandlung_ (1915) – opening of part I | [Project Gutenberg 22367](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/22367) |
| `a-q-zheng-zhuan-zh.txt` | Lu Xun, 阿Q正傳 (1921) – chapters 1 to 4 | [Chinese Wikisource](https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/%E9%98%BFQ%E6%AD%A3%E5%82%B3) |
| `rashomon-ja.txt` | Ryūnosuke Akutagawa, 羅生門 (1915) – complete | [Project Gutenberg 1982](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1982) |

All four works are in the public domain worldwide.
